source: (cd lp-fw/fw-esp32c6 && cargo build --target riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf --profile release-esp32 --features esp32c6,server,radio) && PORT_DEV=/dev/cu.usbmodem1433201 scripts/emu/desk-flash-no-monitor.sh -- flash --chip esp32c6 --port /dev/cu.usbmodem1433201 --partition-table lp-fw/fw-esp32c6/partitions.csv --flash-size 4mb --after hard-reset target/riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf/release-esp32/fw-esp32c6 && sleep 8 && scripts/emu/tty-capture.py --dev /dev/cu.usbmodem1433201 --out target/validate/usb-negative-control.cap --seconds 30 --until '"hostDrainingAgainMs"'

trust.because: the board is the ground truth; nothing models it
a real clock on real flash with real wait states
a scope or a logic analyser on the header pin is the definition of what the pin did
a real host really attaches, or really does not
the real ROM and the real IDF bootloader printed it
real bytes over a real port
